title: Only 1/10 Can Pass This Catholic Trivia Quiz
summary: Ten questions test your knowledge of Catholic worship, Scripture, prayer and the liturgical year.

landing.intro: The first questions may feel familiar, but the final few expose gaps even regular churchgoers miss.

about.body:
This worldwide-English entertainment quiz contains ten questions about Catholic worship, sacraments, Scripture, prayer and the liturgical year.

Choose the single best answer each time. The questions focus on widely recognised Catholic teaching and practice rather than local customs.

Your score measures performance on this short trivia set only and says nothing about anyone's faith, devotion or standing within the Church.

steps: Read each Catholic trivia question carefully.
Choose one answer from the four options.
Reveal your score and full answer review after question ten.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz is not religious instruction or a judgement of faith.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your Catholic trivia score and complete answer review are ready.

profile-1.title: The Catholic Scholar
profile-1.copy: You moved confidently through worship, Scripture, prayer and the Church year. Very few Catholic trivia questions are likely to catch you out.

profile-2.title: The Parish Expert
profile-2.copy: Your Catholic knowledge is broad and dependable. Only one or two of the more detailed questions stood between you and a perfect score.

profile-3.title: The Informed Observer
profile-3.copy: You recognised many core Catholic beliefs and practices. The full review fills in a few details that are easy to overlook.

profile-4.title: The Curious Learner
profile-4.copy: Some traditions were familiar while others proved surprisingly specific. Your answer review gives you the complete picture.

profile-5.title: The Open Door
profile-5.copy: This short test found plenty of room for discovery. The final review reveals every answer and the traditions behind the questions.

score.passed: You passed the Catholic trivia challenge!

catholic-q1.question: What is the name of the Catholic Church's central act of worship?

catholic-q2.question: The Pope is also the bishop of which city?

catholic-q3.question: How many sacraments does the Catholic Church recognise?

catholic-q4.question: Which season of the Church year comes immediately before Christmas?

catholic-q5.question: Which set of Rosary mysteries was introduced by Pope John Paul II in 2002?

catholic-q6.question: Which book comes first in the Catholic Bible?

catholic-q7.question: Which sacrament strengthens baptismal grace and is associated with the gifts of the Holy Spirit?

catholic-q8.question: How many Stations of the Cross are traditionally observed?

catholic-q9.question: In the Latin Catholic tradition, which day begins Lent?

answers.a2: The descent of the Holy Spirit
